_comment: German pronunciation overrides for G2P. Phonemes bypass espeak-ng and go straight to the model. Priority on lookup collisions: brand > en > de_foreign > de_native. Keys are matched after normalize_for_lookup() (casefold, NFKD, strip combining marks except on umlauts ä/ö/ü, + -> plus, & -> and, @ -> at, keep alphanumerics). brand/en/de_foreign ported from kikiri-tts PR #28. de_native holds native German words espeak-ng itself mispronounces/garbles (not foreign-derived, not a loanword) — see NOTICE.md.
